laws.rule: Cerro Koi and Cerro Chorori Natural Monuments: MADES publishes daily 08:00 to 16:00 public visiting hours and expressly prohibits camping. Its page says much of the land is privately owned; protected status and a listed walking activity do not grant access across private land.

sources.title: Cerro Koi and Cerro Chorori Natural Monuments official visitor conditions and location
sources.supports: Read directly: named department, access conditions, visiting hours where published, and camping allowed or prohibited.

local-law.note: Named protected site only. National public-use rules apply from the country record. Other departmental and municipal levels not yet checked; no admission amount reproduced.
